page.overview:
What is Kriltic?

{| class="navbox" style="float: left; border: 2px solid red; font-size: 80%; line-height: 140%; padding: 0em; margin: auto; background-color:#000000; background-repeat: repeat-x; align:center; width: 100%;"

WARNING! This page contains content that may be game mechanics and not actual lore }|}}}}|}}. Read at your own risk!

Kriltic are scorpion-like creatures native to LV-742. They serve as minor antagonists in Aliens versus Predator: Extinction.

Krilitc are hostile, arachnid-adjacent creatures with seven limbs. They have four crab-like legs, and two arms ending in sharp hooks. Their seventh limb is a segmented tail, ending in a similarly sharp stinger. Kriltic have many eyes, with larger eyes towards the center and smaller eyes towards the perimeter. These eyes are so numerous and larger that they take up most of the space on the head. No other sensory organs, such as ears, nose, or even a mouth, are very apparent on the animal. However, since they can be infested by a Facehugger, presumably there is some kind of orifice on the face.
